name: solution-features
description: Heading and lede on the left, numbered feature cards ruled in brand colours on the right; one column below 1001px. Live: the .epx-feat section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

title_accent.description: Words inside the heading painted with the brand gradient; must appear in title.

items.description: Cards. Each: title and body; optional icon_svg (the number glyph) and accent (#5044e1 indigo, #e61c55 red, #00a991 green, #de8d14 yellow — or the tone name).

variant.description: solution: the six solution pages (phone headings balance). readiness / service: Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification / Help Desk. steps: the number and title share a line and the copy runs full width under them (Partners: How the Reseller Process Works).

list_title.description: Optional heading over the cards (an h3; the card titles then become h4), e.g. How the Reseller Process Works.

cta_label.description: Optional gradient button under the lede. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Button destination (a page, #anchor, http(s) or mailto:).
